subject.title: Feature Request: Cross-platform migration tool (migrate export/import)

question: Should OpenClaw own an automated cross-platform import/restore command for local state, or should core stay with safer backup export/verify/convert plus user-driven restore documentation?
rationale: Current main does not implement the requested workflow, and the prior implementation PR was closed after maintainer concern that automated restore creates a large security surface.

options.title: Conservative Backup Path
options.body: Extend `openclaw backup` with selective or platform-targeted export/convert and document user-driven restore without automated archive writes into live state.

options.title: Automated Import Path
options.body: Approve a preview-first import/restore design with canonical target validation, symlink and hardlink safety, resource limits, rollback, and focused security tests.

options.title: Defer Migration Product Work
options.body: Keep manual backup/copy/doctor guidance only until backup and state storage are more mature.

recommendation.title: Conservative Backup Path
recommendation.body: Extend `openclaw backup` with selective or platform-targeted export/convert and document user-driven restore without automated archive writes into live state.

likelyOwner.reason: This person gave the clearest maintainer signal on automated restore security in the linked PR discussion and has adjacent backup hardening history.
